# PR #2343: Patch: a job ran over 7 minutes

Closes #2323

Closes #2323.

## What changed and why

The 7m 7s job in the report ran before #2288 split `rust (test server)` into four groups (`server`, `server api`, `server practice`, `server practice rulings`), which is already on `main` — so the reported job itself is fixed. What remained was thin headroom in the `server` group: half its run was one test, `bots::seat::r2214000_a_strength_zero_miss_makes_far_fewer_beginners_mistakes_than_random`, which played 20 seeded games one after another.

The only file changed is [crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-2323/crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs): the old loop body is now `miss_tally(game: usize) -> MissTally` (one game's counts, byte-for-byte the same logic, seeds and draws unchanged), and the test runs all 20 games side by side on `std::thread::scope` threads, then sums the per-game tallies. Assertions, `GAMES`, `DRAWS`, seeds, PREMISE floors and the printed report are untouched. No `.github/` change, no spec change (R2214000's note and `proven_in` stay as they are).

## How it was tested

Each command below was run and its output seen:

- Baseline before the edit: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server bots::seat::r2214000_a_strength_zero_miss_makes_far_fewer -- --nocapture` → 1 passed in 64.22 s, printing `ended the turn with a card to play: random 0.098, miss 0.021 (93 and 20 of 950); attacked below standing still: random 0.105, miss 0.010 (33 and 3 of 314)`.
- After the edit: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server bots::seat:: -- --nocapture` → all 17 pass, and the R2214000 line is identical character for character, which is the evidence the refactor counts the same picks.
- Speed under CI's flags (`CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 ... --config profile.test.package.jackioh-engine.opt-level=1 --config profile.test.package.jackioh-cards.opt-level=1 --test server`, this box has 2 cores vs CI's 4): the R2214000 test alone went from 73.68 s sequential to 60.79 s threaded. Whole `tests/server.rs` binary: 281.40 s before vs 283.89 s after — indistinguishable on 2 shared cores, since the ~13 s test saving is ~5% of the binary here; the plan's 96 s → ~76 s expectation was measured on a 4-core EPYC where the saving is proportionally larger. No number here is claimed for CI hardware beyond the test-level before/after on the same box.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` (1472 rulings, 3336 proofs: ok), `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` — all pass.

## Decisions the task did not settle

- One thread per game, all 20 at once, rather than batches of `available_parallelism()` (how `honest_win` batches, because it needs seed order): game `r2214000-rates-10` alone takes ~20 s while the others take 1–8 s, so batching took 37.6 s vs 31 s unbatched on the plan's 4-core box, with less code.
- No `ci.yml` change: `server`'s filter is untouched, and the bot may not touch `.github/` anyway.
- The AI's test opt-level stays as is: raising `profile.test.package.jackioh-ai` to 1 compiles 12 s longer and runs only 12 s faster on `server` (worse on the practice groups), to 2 even worse.
- `GAMES`, `DRAWS`, seeds, PREMISE floors and assertions unchanged — changing them would weaken the check.

## For the reviewer

Determinism holds because each game reads only its own seeded `Rng`s and totals are order-independent sums; a game-thread panic is re-raised with its message via `resume_unwind` (not `.unwrap()`). Known non-issue: R2214000's Measured paragraph still quotes older counts (95/19 of 1008, 20/3 of 302) while the test prints 93/20 of 950 and 33/3 of 314 — refreshing that note is a person's call, outside this issue.
